name: Concentric Circle Arc Extraction
description: Extract arcs from concentric circles that span the same angular amount
problem: When extracting SubCurve arcs from circles of different radii, using the same domain value produces different angular spans because circles use arc-length parameterization

solution.principle: Scale domain by each circle's radius to achieve equal angles
solution.explanation: Circle parameterization is 0 to 2πR (arc length), so domain/radius = angle

anti_patterns.mistake: Using same domain for both circles
anti_patterns.symptom: Non-wedge shapes, inner arc spans different angle than outer
anti_patterns.why_wrong: Arc-length parameterization means same domain ≠ same angle

anti_patterns.symptom: Domain values produce microscopic or invisible changes

diagnostic_questions.question: Are you extracting arcs from circles of different sizes?
diagnostic_questions.if_yes: You likely need separate domains scaled by radius

diagnostic_questions.question: Are the resulting shapes distorted (not proper wedges)?
diagnostic_questions.if_yes: The inner and outer arcs probably span different angles

diagnostic_questions.question: Are slider changes producing microscopic effects?
diagnostic_questions.if_yes: Domain values are probably wrong scale for the curve parameterization

verification.expected: Both arcs should visually span 45°, but outer arc is longer
